# Documents and Environments

This part asks how an analysis rebuilds, as a document, on someone
else's machine. It opens the second quarter and assumes a dataset
of the kind Part III produces.

- @sec-quarto writes the analysis as a Quarto document whose
  numbers are computed rather than typed.
- @sec-renv records the package versions the analysis used in a
  lockfile and restores them elsewhere.
- @sec-docker pins the R version, operating system, and system
  libraries in a container.
- @sec-zzcollab assembles the pieces into a research compendium and
  audits it against the Five Pillars.
- @sec-targets turns the analysis into a pipeline that rebuilds only
  what an edit has invalidated.
- @sec-cloud moves a job to a cluster or a cloud instance when a
  laptop is not enough.

If the quiz at the start of a chapter is easy, skip to the next.
The first three chapters each add one layer of the environment and
are best read in order; the last three depend on them but not on
one another.
